findings.title: Cache deletion leaves the connected-calendars query stale
findings.body: After deleting the cache, this handler only invokes an optional callback and does not invalidate `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`, whose response supplies `cacheUpdatedAt`. When no callback invalidates that query, the dropdown continues to show the deleted cache and its delete action until the page is refreshed.

findings.title: The environment-file update uses macOS-only sed syntax
findings.body: On GNU/Linux, `sed -i ''` is not the macOS-compatible in-place edit syntax and fails when `GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL` already exists. Because the script does not stop on errors, it still prints that the URL was updated even though the environment file remains unchanged.

findings.title: The environment-file path depends on the caller's working directory
findings.body: `ENV_FILE` is resolved relative to the current directory, not this script's location. When invoked from the repository root as `./scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh`, `../.env` points outside the repository, so the script creates or edits the wrong file and the app does not load the webhook URL it reports setting.
